findings.claim: Entering 경명여중 produces newly written problems with that school’s real problem structure.
findings.observed: No math creation UI, zero current own-school evidence, no semantic structure contract or generation call.

findings.claim: Different schools with different evidence can change the actual blueprint and row selection.
findings.observed: Fixed synthetic corpus A gives10 MC/10-point-grid, B gives20 short/5-point-grid; selected IDs differ and repeats are deterministic.
findings.limitation: Synthetic mechanism proof, not actual-school fidelity or total content capacity.

findings.claim: School-name text itself determines the school’s problem style.
findings.observed: Same evidence gives same numeric blueprint under renamed school; two absent schools share identical selected questions under the same cohort.

findings.claim: Long/short school aliases resolve to own-school history at prediction endpoints.
findings.observed: Normalizer exists separately; endpoints and evidence split compare literal strings. Synthetic long spelling has own evidence1 while unmatched input has own evidence0.

findings.claim: Same-school unit/difficulty/type labels guarantee matching mathematical structure.
findings.observed: qtype is response format; familyKey/semantic/task structure absent from both prediction and candidate contracts. Slot exactness never proves a mathematical structure match.

findings.claim: Predicted-paper issuance creates new question text or fills gaps by invoking a generator/AI.
findings.observed: Existing Problem rows are selected. No arithmetic/math generator, generateProblems, transformProblem, TypeSafe or Jev hook is called. Only Test and TestProblem are written.

findings.claim: Prediction and issuance use the same source/trust policy.
findings.observed: Prediction excludes 대비 and unknown source paths; issuance uses partitionTrusted only. Synthetic own evidence0 in prediction becomes2 in issuance.

findings.claim: Prediction and issuance use the same own-school style history.
findings.observed: Prediction learns style across own-school subjects and restricts range history; issuance loads only requested subject. Cross-subject-only fixture predicts20 questions but issuance refuses no evidence.

findings.claim: An attached PredictionRun binds the issued paper to its stored blueprint and full exam identity.
findings.observed: Only run user/school/level/grade compared; subject, target/cutoff, parameters and saved blueprint not bound; fresh calculation performed.

findings.claim: MC and short representations of a proven same question occupy only one paper slot.
findings.observed: Candidate mapper drops questionGroupKey; composer uses Problem IDs only. Fixture selected10 rows but9 logical questions with no relaxation and no missing slots.
findings.limitation: Concrete fixture failure; not a measurement of existing production duplicate incidence.

findings.claim: Current identity/content/eligibility is rechecked and locked immediately before predicted-paper persistence.
findings.observed: Real persist function with transaction spies performs no Problem reread/lock or identity uniqueness check; general flow has selectionStillCurrent but this path does not use it.

findings.claim: A completed100-point predicted paper guarantees all requested school unit/difficulty/format slots matched.
findings.observed: Every slot may relax all3 axes and reach persistence with100 points,10 rows and0 missing slots.

findings.claim: Training evidence is strictly earlier than cutoff/target; same/future periods are rejected.
findings.observed: Service filters plus pure predictor assertion; reversed cutoff refused before prediction writes.

findings.claim: Final selected questions obey the same historical source-exam cutoff as training evidence.
findings.observed: Candidate query has requested units/eligibility only, no school/source-exam-period predicate. Actual historical leakage incidence unmeasured.

findings.claim: Cohort-only fallback is visible in machine metadata and existing prediction dashboard judgement.
findings.observed: Own evidence0/confidence0/reference0; run risk flags; dashboard blocks own evidence<2.
findings.limitation: Issuance API has no explicit cohort-only warning or separate generation UI confirmation flow.

findings.claim: Every student/branch relationship is validated in this predicted-paper path.
findings.observed: Approved session/menu and literal class owner are checked; student membership and branch-specific action policy not verified here; live authorization integration tests out of scope.

findings.claim: A current real-school request works through production printing and student issuance.
findings.observed: No HTTP mutation, real DB write or production rendering/dispatch was performed. Root separately owns immutable-export runtime probes.

doesNotProve: declared total equals extracted score sum

uiDashboard.fact: Reads existing rounds and explicitly states prediction execution UI is absent.

uiApi.fact: Reads /api/exam/rounds; only prediction-related mutation is actual score saving.

bankSchoolSearch.fact: School text belongs to generic q search, not a predictor request.

bankSearchWhere.fact: q searches content/code/answer/solution/school and numeric questionNumber.

predictionRoute.fact: Session and schema guard, then runPrediction and 201 response.

predictionEvidence.fact: Exact school split; own cross-subject style, subject-specific range, strict pre-cutoff trust and source guards.

pinnedEvidence.fact: Pinned replays check existence/schema/series/time while intentionally bypassing trust/source filters.

predictionRiskAndWrite.fact: No individual score predictions; risk/evidence metadata and fresh PredictionRun are persisted.

schoolRequestContract.fact: School string length only; qtype is response format; blueprint has distributions, not problem-family/semantic requirements.

schoolNormalizer.fact: Separate normalizer maps long/short school spellings, including 경명여중.

predictorDefaults.fact: Engine v0.6.0; decay .85, same-round boost 4, style prior 0, total prior 2, grid prior 0/decay .4, own unit weight .25.

predictor.fact: Deterministic evidence-based marginal distributions; no evidence throws, no semantic school-name understanding.

generateRoute.fact: Separate issuance request; returns numeric evidence/confidence and per-question relaxations.

generateConvert.fact: Exam conversion is not the same full-schema path; candidate mapping drops familyKey and questionGroupKey.

generateEvidence.fact: Same-subject own/cohort papers strictly before target; trust only, with no isSchoolExam call.

generateAuthRun.fact: Class owner and optional run owner/school/level/grade; no run subject/target/cutoff/params/saved blueprint binding.

generateCandidates.fact: Eligible shared bank rows by requested units, compose, persist; no candidate school/source-period filter and no content-generation call.

candidateContract.fact: ID/unit/difficulty/response type/source/origin/score only; no family, logical question identity, text or semantic constraints.

paperResponseContract.fact: Caller supplies units/series/target; evidenceCount 0 means cohort-only. No typed cohort-only warning field.

composeSlots.fact: Independent marginal expansion; unit4/difficulty2/type1 relaxation costs; raw topics with no unitId provide no unit constraint.

composeRanking.fact: Lexicographic relaxation penalty, exact same-school row ID, source rank, stable ID; used set contains row IDs.

composeOutput.fact: Missing slots and relaxations returned; score normalization applies to selected existing rows.

trust.fact: Declared score band95..105 and >=10 questions; not an authenticity, exact100 or declared-vs-question-sum proof.

source.fact: Known nonblank path without 대비 is classified school exam; null/blank excluded as unknown.

normalize.fact: Centi-point school grid and exact100; impossible grid refused.

persist.fact: Reject unavailable/incomplete/non100; check class owner; write Test/TestProblem references and scores, no Problem creation or revalidation.

questionIdentity.fact: Logical question ID is questionGroupKey or independent legacy row ID.

identitySchema.fact: Family and logical question group differ; TestProblem continues to reference scalar Problem IDs.

safeGeneralSelection.fact: General test flow locks/rechecks eligibility, logical identity, family and content; predicted persistence does not call it.

menu.fact: Tests/predictions require export menu at proxy.

proxy.fact: Account menu and role checks before route handler.

uiDisclosure.fact: UI blocks prediction numbers for own evidence<2, unknown confidence or low confidence.

uiDisclosurePanel.fact: Blocked judgement shows unavailable message and basis metadata instead of blueprint numbers.

aiSeparate.fact: Separate AI problem generator calls callAi; input has unit/label/difficulty/count, no school.

aiSeparateRoute.fact: Separate endpoint invokes generator and persists pending content; absent from predictor call chain.

transformSeparate.fact: Separate origin-based AI transformation; absent from predictor call chain.

verification.ioIsolation: Hoisted db mock; service persistence mock; actual persistence function imported separately against in-memory transaction spies. No route handler/HTTP call or real DB/API write.
